categories.assessment: Twelve failures occur at process-state expectations, a /proc-based pre-signal assertion, or safe-resume liveness guards. The original failures and one current metadata probe support this classification; the twelve tests were not rerun individually.
One original traceback directly records EPERM from the socket constructor before HTTP assertions.
Two failures involve interpreter spelling. One is directly visible in retained child-test output; a metadata-only child independently reproduces the resume settings mismatch.

Two exact interface expectations disagree with the current richer error string or native time-budget argv. Tests mock these operations; the stale-expectation interpretation does not establish when the mismatch was introduced.
Two archival expectations for other task IDs fail. Their cause and historical provenance were not resolved by a pristine baseline replay.
